method: public bytes only: download the dataset files, recompute git-blob SHA-1, compare declared numbers across surfaces
subject: axis governance (csoai/gspc-gov) vs live board
findings: The dataset's axis-live.jsonl says separation UNTESTED; the live board says TIE for the same axis and the same run. One of the two artefacts is stale.
axis-live.jsonl is not listed in manifest.jsonl, so its bytes are unverifiable against the dataset's own integrity record.
The per-item model results (csoai/gspc-peritem-rows-2026-08-12) return HTTP 401: the fleet_mean cannot be independently recomputed from public bytes.
limits: This record checks published bytes; it does not re-run a model or validate that the run happened.
A separation label is a determination, not a measurement; disagreement between artefacts is a publication defect, not a numeric error.

summary.scope: every MEASURED axis on GET /api/gspc compared to the public axis-live.jsonl of the dataset it names
summary.impact: the headline '0 of 14 separated · 7 TIE · 7 UNTESTED' is derived from board labels that disagree with 8 of the datasets they cite; one side is stale and the public cannot tell which
